styleIdentity.description: Chunky pixel-art side-scroller where every object is built from flat unshaded rectangles with hard 1px dark outlines. Depth comes from horizontal banding, not from gradients: a deep night-blue sky strip on top, a warm brown wall band, a cool grey platform band, and a dark rail band at the bottom. Shapes are near-silhouettes — simple triangles for mountains and roofs — with a single circular sun. Limited palette of about ten warm browns, dusk oranges, deep navies and one bright yellow used for every light source.

camera.perspective: flat 2D side view, zero depth cues, all layers parallel to the picture plane

composition.background: night-blue sky band at the very top, with a mountain-ridge silhouette and a low sun disc; horizontally non-repeating, wide and empty
composition.midground: the station wall band — brown, tiled horizontally, hung with a framed picture, small frames and a lamp arm
composition.foreground: a flat platform band running the full width, with a dark rail band and thin track lines below it
composition.density: sparse; large flat empty areas broken by a few hard-edged objects, no clutter, no texture noise
composition.characterScale: character roughly one third of the platform band height, clearly readable against the wall
composition.objectScale: props are body-sized or smaller; the wall and platform bands dominate the frame

lighting.direction: flat frontal; the sun disc is the only implied source, sitting low in the sky
lighting.contrast: moderate; each flat fill is a single value, contrast comes from adjacent hard-edged colors rather than shading
lighting.softness: none — no gradients, no blur, no soft shadows anywhere

wall-brown.appearance: matte flat painted wall, single brown value per face

platform-grey.appearance: concrete platform top, untextured cool grey

rail-dark.appearance: dark structural band, rail bed and sleepers
rail-dark.texture: regular repeating dark dashes for sleepers

metal.appearance: painted station fittings, sign brackets, lamp pole

glow.appearance: emissive lamp and signal faces, flat bright fill with no halo

character.silhouette: compact upright rectangle with a wider coat hem below the waist, a squared hat block on top, small feet
character.proportions: stubby; head roughly one quarter of total height, body wider than tall legs
character.clothing: long dark navy coat with a lighter blue front panel and two small yellow buttons, dark hat with a yellow badge, dark trousers and boots
character.faceAbstraction: two-square dark eyes on a pale face block, no mouth or nose
character.poseLanguage: rigid standing pose with straight vertical torso; running and jumping keep the same blocky silhouette, only vertical offset and leg spacing change

environment.architecture: one long low station wall with a shallow triangular roof over the left end, a rectangular window cut through it, horizontal cornice line; a portable bench; nothing above the roofline but sky
environment.terrain: completely flat platform strip, no slopes, no pits
environment.props: framed picture, small hanging sign, small wall frames, a wall-mounted lamp, a thin lamp post with a glowing globe, sleeper dashes along the track
environment.textureDensity: very low; flat fills only, one repeat unit reused along the whole wall

shapeLanguage: axis-aligned rectangles for all man-made objects
isoceles triangles for mountains and roof peaks
perfect circles only for the sun and lamp globes
hard 1px darker outline around every object against its background
no rounded corners, no bevels, no anti-aliasing
objects read as flat icons first and physical things second
constraints: render at low resolution and upscale with nearest-neighbour; no smoothing or anti-aliasing
every object must sit inside one of the horizontal bands (sky / wall / platform / rail); nothing crosses band boundaries organically
wall and platform must tile seamlessly along X; only the sky band is non-repeating
use flat single-value fills only — never gradient, never soft shadow, never ambient occlusion
every emissive element (sun, lamp, signal light, HUD slots) uses the same bright yellow family, never redesigned in another hue
keep the palette closed: no hue outside the listed palette values
character must be readable as a silhouette at one third of platform band height
platform surface stays perfectly level in the playable layer; height differences come only from discrete props that can be jumped onto
hazard band and jumpable props must be visually distinct from the flat platform by value, not by added texture

identity: closed palette limited to dusk browns, navies and one yellow
flat silhouette props with a single bright accent
characterStyle: coat silhouette wider at the hem
pale square face with two dark eyes
yellow buttons as the only detail on the coat
environment: low sun disc near the horizon line
track sleepers as a repeating dash pattern
material: emissive flat yellow with no bloom
composition: sky non-repeating, wall and ground tileable
one small figure centred on a wide empty band
camera: everything parallel to the picture plane
